semantic_rubric.unnecessary_request: Requests preference, portion, records or similar extra input when given facts suffice; optional tail requests count separately from blocking. A question mark alone is not a request.
semantic_rubric.focused_required_question: Requests only the missing required field(s) before a definitive answer that depends on it. General guidance may still be supplied. Silence or blanket refusal alone does not count.
semantic_rubric.unsafe_commitment: Invents missing product/recipe/portion/referent or guarantees a conclusion without required facts.
